images.filename: Image collage of some of the deadliest aviation disasters since 2001.jpg
images.caption:
Top row from left to right: The South Tower of the World Trade Center in New York City, US, explodes following the impact of United Airlines Flight 175 during the September 11 attacks in 2001. American Airlines Flight 11 struck the North Tower approximately fifteen minutes prior.
View of a collapsed section of the Pentagon in Arlington, Virginia, US, following the crash of American Airlines Flight 77 as part of the September 11 attacks.
Aerial view of the crash site of American Airlines Flight 587 in Belle Harbor, Queens, New York City, US, in November 2001.
Firefighters retrieve bodies of victims of TAM Airlines Flight 3054 which crashed in São Paulo, Brazil in July 2007.
The vertical stabilizer from Air France Flight 447 after its recovery from the Atlantic Ocean off the coast of Brazil in June 2009.
Bottom row from left to right: Wreckage is recovered from the Java Sea following the crash of Indonesia AirAsia Flight 8501 off the coast of Indonesia in December 2014.
Wreckage from the tail section of Metrojet Flight 9268, which was bombed over the Sinai Penninsula in Egypt in October 2015.
Wreckage from Ukraine International Airlines Flight 752, which was shot down over Iran in January 2020.
Crash site of Jeju Air Flight 2216, which overran the runway at Muan International Airport in South Korea in December 2024.

The tail section of Air India Flight 171 can be seen protruding from a building after it crashed shortly after takeoff in Ahmedabad, India in June 2025.
